Last Sunday, Ben and Lily went to the school library. Ben spent the weekend at the library. Life is full of small surprises. What's more, my grandfather has collected stamps over a lifetime.
Ben hopes to visit Toronto one day. Ben and Lily had great fun there. It takes twenty minutes to get to the school library by bike. The bakery displays fresh bread in the window.
Ben usually has chicken for breakfast. Ben learned a lot about science. They took many photos at the teachers' office. The lab demos run on open day.
Ben thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. Ben likes snowy days best. There are always many people at the teachers' office.
